Use case: compositing / garment close-up for image-to-video.
Produce one clean, highly photorealistic portrait 9:16 camera frame, with NO text or graphical elements.
Use the approved three-panel reference storyboard's MIDDLE panel as the shot. It is the same fictional female host in a dark charcoal SJ WANI fine-knit crew-neck pullover, with ivory trousers, inside a warm taupe home-shopping studio. The actual product reference is a close-fitting, delicate fine-knit, slightly shimmering dark charcoal long-sleeved PULLOVER, no buttons and no cardigan opening.
Tight crop from below her mouth / lower neck to her waist, with the garment texture and both naturally formed hands prominent. Her left forearm rests diagonally in front of her torso; her right thumb and index finger gently hold the edge of the left sleeve cuff to show the knit fabric. Natural delicate five-finger hands, anatomically normal wrists, physically believable sleeve geometry, no excessive stretching, no separate unconnected fabric pieces, no visible face required. The same natural realistic adult skin tone as in the storyboard. Soft bright television studio light, garment texture sharp, background softly blurred. Preserve the exact charcoal knit appearance from the product reference, not thick rib knit.
There is room around the hands to allow subtle demonstration motion later. This is a single uninterrupted photo, not a split screen. No logos, titles, caption, watermark, collage, price or UI.

Use case: identity-preserve / fashion home-shopping image-to-video source.
Create ONE clean photorealistic portrait 9:16 full-body camera frame, no collage, no text.
Use the right panel of the approved storyboard as the visual target. Preserve the fictional Korean female host's identity, dark-brown shoulder-length hair, around 40s, as in the other reference source photo.
She wears the same charcoal grey SJ WANI long-sleeved fine-knit crew-neck PULLOVER, ivory tailored straight/wide-leg trousers, simple black loafers. No blazer, no buttons, no cardigan opening. Same subtle fine-knit charcoal texture and clean hem as the product reference.
Full figure from head through both shoes is comfortably within frame, with extra space around hands and feet. On the same warm taupe/cream television shopping stage, oak furniture and a small clothing rail in the background. Body stands relaxed in a slight three-quarter turn, face toward the camera, one arm softly bent at waist level with an open relaxed palm introducing the outfit, other arm relaxed by her side. Hands are anatomically normal and each has five fingers. She is about to make a small natural quarter turn to show the silhouette. Avoid exaggerated dance pose, twisted limbs or fast-motion blur.
Professional even studio light, realistic skin and fabric, precise fine knit. Warm natural pleasant expression, no large grin.
Remove all headers, lettering, subtitles, graphics, logos, watermarks and live labels. This is an unadorned single photo source for later animation; faithfully follow the approved concept.
